assets.name: terrain-forest
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single square terrain illustration for an original fantasy tabletop strategy game, FOREST terrain. A premium hand-painted storybook fantasy map, lush emerald and moss-green old woodland, a few broad beautifully shaped tree crowns, small rocks, winding earthen clearings, restrained painterly brushwork and warm sunlit details. Orthographic view from almost directly above, tiny amount of volume in the tree crowns, consistent soft light from upper left. Artwork fills the entire square edge to edge and will be clipped by code into a point-up regular hexagon. Composition: large readable masses, quiet small clearing at center reserved for a number token; keep outer corners relatively calm so game buildings remain legible. Deep greens contrasted with warm ochre ground, coherent natural terrain rather than noisy miniature objects. No houses, no figures, no roads, no water, no frame, no border, no lettering, no numbers, no UI, no logos. Crisp highly crafted 2D fantasy illustration, not a photograph, not plastic 3D, no isometric floating island. One terrain image only, not a sheet or collage. Square aspect ratio, high resolution.
